title: Great Golden Hour
text: Excellent tour guide Isabel answered all of our questions and did such a fantastic experience.  We took photos with her too.
author: Caralyn27

title: Learned a lot!
text: Isabel is a very friendly and knowledgeable guide. She made the experience easy and informative, always with a smile.
author: Ross_D

title: The communication with...
text: The communication with the company is excellent! My quide was wonderful - so knowledgeable and clearly loved what she does.
author: Isabelle_A

title: Exceptional Experience
text: Xavier was a fantastic guide! Very knowledgeable and he made our visit leagues better than if we'd gone on our own.
author: A7320ZQcherylk

title: Anna was an exceptional...
text: Anna was an exceptional guide. She is incredibly knowledgeable about Spain’s history, the Sagrada Familia and Park Guelle. She paced the tour perfectly, allowing time to stop and experience everything while making sure we had time to complete everything. She answered so many questions and never made us feel like it was too much. She even offered restaurant suggestions at the end of the tour, and helped us navigate getting to our next place. I cannot say enough about this experience and would gladly do another tour with Anna anytime!!!!
author: Kathy_C

title: Absolutely beautiful!
text: Not to be missed!  Our guide, Xavier, was the best!  He had all the answers!  He made it interactive to see what we knew and filled in all the blanks!  Gave us the complete history of the basilica and the park not overlooking anything and gave us the opportunity to ask questions without making us feel bad!  He did it in such a way that you felt like he was just chatting with you rather than a boring pre-rehearsed lecture!  He was extremely knowledgeable on everything, attractive, and easy to understand!  He slowed down when some of our group needed to but kept everyone engaged while he did it!
author: Floppyhatgigglinggal

title: An educational, engaging and entertaining experience
text: Absolute must experience in Barcelona, whether or not you’re a student of architecture.  Our guide Josep made the tour, very educational, entertaining and engaging.
author: Carlos_M

title: We had a fantastic time....
text: We had a fantastic time. I loved starting at the Parc and ending at Sagrada. It truly was the Golden Hour. The light coming through all the stained glass was magical. We've been to Sagrada at least six times and Faidra was by far the best guide we've had! Thank you for a beautiful afternoon.
author: Tammy_M

title: Sunset tour
text: Best tour ever! Faidra was the best tour guide. She was very knowledgeable and warm and understanding especially with my bad knee would recommend her highly.
author: David_H

title: Informative Tour!
text: Enjoyed the private tour and all the history. We were also able to go at our own pace and beat the crowds!
author: Fatima_K
